passages.text: Again the Israelites did evil in the sight of the LORD, so He delivered them into the hand of the Philistines for forty years.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites did evil.
The LORD saw their evil.
The LORD gave the Israelites into the power of the Philistines.
The Philistines ruled over the Israelites for forty years.
passages.original: וַיֹּסִ֙פוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַיִּתְּנֵ֧ם יְהוָ֛ה בְּיַד־ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים אַרְבָּעִ֥ים שָׁנָֽה׃פ

passages.text: Now there was a man from Zorah named Manoah, from the clan of the Danites, whose wife was barren and had no children.
passages.sermon:
A man lived in Zorah.
His name was Manoah.
He belonged to the clan of the Danites.
Manoah had a wife.
His wife could not have children.
She was barren.
passages.original: וַיְהִי֩ אִ֨ישׁ אֶחָ֧ד מִצָּרְעָ֛ה מִמִּשְׁפַּ֥חַת הַדָּנִ֖י וּשְׁמ֣וֹ מָנ֑וֹחַ וְאִשְׁתּ֥וֹ עֲקָרָ֖ה וְלֹ֥א יָלָֽדָה׃

passages.text: The angel of the LORD appeared to the woman and said to her, “It is true that you are barren and have no children; but you will conceive and give birth to a son.
passages.sermon:
The angel of the LORD appeared to the woman.
The woman was Manoah’s wife.
She was from Zorah.
She belonged to the clan of the Danites.
She could not have children.
The angel spoke to her.
He said, “You are barren.
You have not given birth to any children.
But you will become pregnant.
You will give birth to a son.”
passages.original: וַיֵּרָ֥א מַלְאַךְ־ יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ הָאִשָּׁ֑ה וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלֶ֗יהָ הִנֵּה־ נָ֤א אַתְּ־ עֲקָרָה֙ וְלֹ֣א יָלַ֔דְתְּ וְהָרִ֖ית וְיָלַ֥דְתְּ בֵּֽן׃

passages.text: Now please be careful not to drink wine or strong drink, and not to eat anything unclean.
passages.sermon:
The angel of the LORD spoke to the woman.
He told her to be careful.
He told her not to drink wine.
He told her not to drink strong drink.
He told her not to eat anything unclean.
passages.original: וְעַתָּה֙ הִשָּׁ֣מְרִי נָ֔א וְאַל־ תִּשְׁתִּ֖י יַ֣יִן וְשֵׁכָ֑ר וְאַל־ תֹּאכְלִ֖י כָּל־ טָמֵֽא׃

passages.text: For behold, you will conceive and give birth to a son. And no razor shall come over his head, because the boy will be a Nazirite to God from the womb, and he will begin the deliverance of Israel from the hand of the Philistines.”
passages.sermon:
The angel of the LORD spoke to the woman.
He said, "You will become pregnant.
You will give birth to a son.
Do not cut his hair with a razor.
This boy will be a Nazirite.
He will belong to God from before his birth.
He will begin to save Israel.
He will deliver Israel from the power of the Philistines."
passages.original: כִּי֩ הִנָּ֨ךְ הָרָ֜ה וְיֹלַ֣דְתְּ בֵּ֗ן וּמוֹרָה֙ לֹא־ יַעֲלֶ֣ה עַל־ רֹאשׁ֔וֹ כִּֽי־ נְזִ֧יר אֱלֹהִ֛ים יִהְיֶ֥ה הַנַּ֖עַר מִן־ הַבָּ֑טֶן וְה֗וּא יָחֵ֛ל לְהוֹשִׁ֥יעַ אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מִיַּ֥ד פְּלִשְׁתִּֽים׃

passages.text: So the woman went and told her husband, “A man of God came to me. His appearance was like the angel of God, exceedingly awesome. I did not ask him where he came from, and he did not tell me his name.
passages.sermon:
The woman saw a man of God.
She went to her husband.
She spoke to her husband.
She said, "A man of God came to me.
He looked like an angel of God.
He looked very awesome.
I did not ask him where he came from.
He did not tell me his name."
passages.original: וַתָּבֹ֣א הָאִשָּׁ֗ה וַתֹּ֣אמֶר לְאִישָׁהּ֮ לֵאמֹר֒ אִ֤ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים֙ בָּ֣א אֵלַ֔י וּמַרְאֵ֕הוּ כְּמַרְאֵ֛ה מַלְאַ֥ךְ הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים נוֹרָ֣א מְאֹ֑ד וְלֹ֤א שְׁאִלְתִּ֙יהוּ֙ אֵֽי־ מִזֶּ֣ה ה֔וּא וְאֶת־ שְׁמ֖וֹ לֹֽא־ הִגִּ֥יד לִֽי׃

passages.text: But he said to me, ‘Behold, you will conceive and give birth to a son. Now, therefore, do not drink wine or strong drink, and do not eat anything unclean, because the boy will be a Nazirite to God from the womb until the day of his death.’ ”
passages.sermon:
A man of God spoke to me.
He said, “You will become pregnant.
You will give birth to a son.
Do not drink wine.
Do not drink strong drink.
Do not eat anything unclean.
The boy will be a Nazirite.
He will belong to God.
He will be a Nazirite from the womb.
He will remain a Nazirite until the day of his death.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לִ֔י הִנָּ֥ךְ הָרָ֖ה וְיֹלַ֣דְתְּ בֵּ֑ן וְעַתָּ֞ה אַל־ תִּשְׁתִּ֣י׀ יַ֣יִן וְשֵׁכָ֗ר וְאַל־ תֹּֽאכְלִי֙ כָּל־ טֻמְאָ֔ה כִּֽי־ נְזִ֤יר אֱלֹהִים֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה הַנַּ֔עַר מִן־ הַבֶּ֖טֶן עַד־ י֥וֹם מוֹתֽוֹ׃פ

passages.text: Then Manoah prayed to the LORD, “Please, O Lord, let the man of God You sent us come to us again to teach us how to raise the boy who is to be born.”
passages.sermon:
Manoah was the husband of the woman who saw the man of God.
Manoah prayed to the LORD.
He said, “Please, Lord, let the man of God come to us again.
You sent this man of God before.
Let him teach us what we should do for the boy who will be born.”
passages.original: וַיֶּעְתַּ֥ר מָנ֛וֹחַ אֶל־ יְהוָ֖ה וַיֹּאמַ֑ר בִּ֣י אֲדוֹנָ֔י אִ֣ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֞ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׁלַ֗חְתָּ יָבוֹא־ נָ֥א עוֹד֙ אֵלֵ֔ינוּ וְיוֹרֵ֕נוּ מַֽה־ נַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה לַנַּ֥עַר הַיּוּלָּֽד׃

passages.text: And God listened to the voice of Manoah, and the angel of God returned to the woman as she was sitting in the field; but her husband Manoah was not with her.
passages.sermon:
God heard Manoah’s prayer.
God listened to Manoah’s voice.
The angel of God came again to the woman.
The woman was sitting in the field.
Manoah was her husband.
Manoah was not with her.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֥ע הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים בְּק֣וֹל מָנ֑וֹחַ וַיָּבֹ֣א מַלְאַךְ֩ הָאֱלֹהִ֨ים ע֜וֹד אֶל־ הָאִשָּׁ֗ה וְהִיא֙ יוֹשֶׁ֣בֶת בַּשָּׂדֶ֔ה וּמָנ֥וֹחַ אִישָׁ֖הּ אֵ֥ין עִמָּֽהּ׃

passages.text: The woman ran quickly to tell her husband, “Behold, the man who came to me the other day has reappeared!”
passages.sermon:
The woman saw the man of God again.
She acted quickly.
She ran to her husband.
She told her husband what happened.
She said to him, “The man who came to me the other day has appeared to me again.”
passages.original: וַתְּמַהֵר֙ הָֽאִשָּׁ֔ה וַתָּ֖רָץ וַתַּגֵּ֣ד לְאִישָׁ֑הּ וַתֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֔יו הִנֵּ֨ה נִרְאָ֤ה אֵלַי֙ הָאִ֔ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־ בָּ֥א בַיּ֖וֹם אֵלָֽי׃

passages.text: So Manoah got up and followed his wife. When he came to the man, he asked, “Are you the man who spoke to my wife?” “I am,” he said.
passages.sermon:
Manoah was the husband of the woman.
Manoah got up.
He followed his wife.
Manoah came to the man.
Manoah spoke to the man.
Manoah asked, "Are you the man who spoke to my wife?"
The man answered, "I am."
passages.original: וַיָּ֛קָם וַיֵּ֥לֶךְ מָנ֖וֹחַ אַחֲרֵ֣י אִשְׁתּ֑וֹ וַיָּבֹא֙ אֶל־ הָאִ֔ישׁ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ל֗וֹ הַאַתָּ֥ה הָאִ֛ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־ דִּבַּ֥רְתָּ אֶל־ הָאִשָּׁ֖ה וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אָֽנִי׃

passages.text: Then Manoah asked, “When your words come to pass, what will be the boy’s rule of life and mission?”
passages.sermon:
Manoah was the husband of the woman who saw the man of God.
Manoah spoke to the man of God.
Manoah said, “Your words will come true.”
Manoah asked, “What will be the rule for the boy?”
Manoah asked, “What work will the boy do?”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר מָנ֔וֹחַ עַתָּ֖ה יָבֹ֣א דְבָרֶ֑יךָ מַה־ יִּֽהְיֶ֥ה מִשְׁפַּט־ הַנַּ֖עַר וּמַעֲשֵֽׂהוּ׃

passages.text: So the angel of the LORD answered Manoah, “Your wife is to do everything I told her.
passages.sermon: The angel of the LORD spoke to Manoah.\r\nThe angel said, “Your wife must obey everything I told her.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֛אמֶר מַלְאַ֥ךְ יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מָנ֑וֹחַ מִכֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־ אָמַ֥רְתִּי אֶל־ הָאִשָּׁ֖ה תִּשָּׁמֵֽר׃

passages.text: She must not eat anything that comes from the vine, nor drink any wine or strong drink, nor eat anything unclean. She must do everything I have commanded her.”
passages.sermon:
The angel of the LORD spoke to Manoah.
The angel gave instructions for Manoah’s wife.
She must not eat anything that comes from the grapevine.
She must not drink wine.
She must not drink strong drink.
She must not eat anything unclean.
She must obey everything I have commanded her.
passages.original: מִכֹּ֣ל אֲשֶׁר־ יֵצֵא֩ מִגֶּ֨פֶן הַיַּ֜יִן לֹ֣א תֹאכַ֗ל וְיַ֤יִן וְשֵׁכָר֙ אַל־ תֵּ֔שְׁתְּ וְכָל־ טֻמְאָ֖ה אַל־ תֹּאכַ֑ל כֹּ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ צִוִּיתִ֖יהָ תִּשְׁמֹֽר׃

passages.text: “Please stay here,” Manoah said to the angel of the LORD, “and we will prepare a young goat for you.”
passages.sermon: Manoah spoke to the angel of the LORD.\r\nManoah said, “Please stay here.”\r\nManoah said, “We will prepare a young goat for you.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר מָנ֖וֹחַ אֶל־ מַלְאַ֣ךְ יְהוָ֑ה נַעְצְרָה־ נָּ֣א אוֹתָ֔ךְ וְנַעֲשֶׂ֥ה לְפָנֶ֖יךָ גְּדִ֥י עִזִּֽים׃

passages.text: And the angel of the LORD replied, “Even if I stay, I will not eat your food. But if you prepare a burnt offering, offer it to the LORD.” For Manoah did not know that it was the angel of the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The angel of the LORD spoke to Manoah.
The angel said, “If you keep me here, I will not eat your food.
If you prepare a burnt offering, offer it to the LORD.”
Manoah did not know that this was the angel of the LORD.
passages.original: וַיֹּאמֶר֩ מַלְאַ֨ךְ יְהוָ֜ה אֶל־ מָנ֗וֹחַ אִם־ תַּעְצְרֵ֙נִי֙ לֹא־ אֹכַ֣ל בְּלַחְמֶ֔ךָ וְאִם־ תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה עֹלָ֔ה לַיהוָ֖ה תַּעֲלֶ֑נָּה כִּ֚י לֹא־ יָדַ֣ע מָנ֔וֹחַ כִּֽי־ מַלְאַ֥ךְ יְהוָ֖ה הֽוּא׃

passages.text: Then Manoah said to the angel of the LORD, “What is your name, so that we may honor you when your word comes to pass?”
passages.sermon:
Manoah spoke to the angel of the LORD.
Manoah did not know the angel was from the LORD.
Manoah asked the angel, “What is your name?”
Manoah wanted to honor the angel.
Manoah said he would honor the angel when the angel’s word came true.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֧אמֶר מָנ֛וֹחַ אֶל־ מַלְאַ֥ךְ יְהוָ֖ה מִ֣י שְׁמֶ֑ךָ כִּֽי־ יָבֹ֥א דִבְרֶיךָ וְכִבַּדְנֽוּךָ׃

passages.text: “Why do you ask my name,” said the angel of the LORD, “since it is beyond comprehension?”
passages.sermon:
The angel of the LORD spoke to Manoah.
The angel said, “Why do you ask my name?”
My name is wonderful.
You cannot understand it.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לּוֹ֙ מַלְאַ֣ךְ יְהוָ֔ה לָ֥מָּה זֶּ֖ה תִּשְׁאַ֣ל לִשְׁמִ֑י וְהוּא־ פֶ֛לִאי׃ס

passages.text: Then Manoah took a young goat and a grain offering and offered them on a rock to the LORD. And as Manoah and his wife looked on, the LORD did a marvelous thing.
passages.sermon:
Manoah was a man who wanted to honor the LORD.
Manoah took a young goat.
Manoah also took a grain offering.
Manoah placed the young goat and the grain offering on a rock.
Manoah offered them to the LORD.
Manoah and his wife watched.
The LORD did a marvelous thing as they watched.
passages.original: וַיִּקַּ֨ח מָנ֜וֹחַ אֶת־ גְּדִ֤י הָעִזִּים֙ וְאֶת־ הַמִּנְחָ֔ה וַיַּ֥עַל עַל־ הַצּ֖וּר לַֽיהוָ֑ה וּמַפְלִ֣א לַעֲשׂ֔וֹת וּמָנ֥וֹחַ וְאִשְׁתּ֖וֹ רֹאִֽים׃

passages.text: When the flame went up from the altar to the sky, the angel of the LORD ascended in the flame. When Manoah and his wife saw this, they fell facedown to the ground.
passages.sermon:
The angel of the LORD appeared to Manoah and his wife.
The angel of the LORD was God's messenger.
A flame rose from the altar toward the sky.
The angel of the LORD went up in the flame from the altar.
Manoah and his wife saw this happen.
Manoah and his wife fell with their faces to the ground.
passages.original: וַיְהִי֩ בַעֲל֨וֹת הַלַּ֜הַב מֵעַ֤ל הַמִּזְבֵּ֙חַ֙ הַשָּׁמַ֔יְמָה וַיַּ֥עַל מַלְאַךְ־ יְהוָ֖ה בְּלַ֣הַב הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וּמָנ֤וֹחַ וְאִשְׁתּוֹ֙ רֹאִ֔ים וַיִּפְּל֥וּ עַל־ פְּנֵיהֶ֖ם אָֽרְצָה׃

passages.text: And when the angel of the LORD did not appear again to Manoah and his wife, Manoah realized that it had been the angel of the LORD.
passages.sermon: The angel of the LORD stopped appearing to Manoah and his wife.\r\nManoah understood this.\r\nManoah realized it was the angel of the LORD.
passages.original: וְלֹא־ יָ֤סַף עוֹד֙ מַלְאַ֣ךְ יְהוָ֔ה לְהֵרָאֹ֖ה אֶל־ מָנ֣וֹחַ וְאֶל־ אִשְׁתּ֑וֹ אָ֚ז יָדַ֣ע מָנ֔וֹחַ כִּֽי־ מַלְאַ֥ךְ יְהוָ֖ה הֽוּא׃

passages.text: “We are going to die,” he said to his wife, “for we have seen God!”
passages.sermon:
Manoah was a man.
He spoke to his wife.
He said, “We will die.”
He said this because they had seen God.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֧אמֶר מָנ֛וֹחַ אֶל־ אִשְׁתּ֖וֹ מ֣וֹת נָמ֑וּת כִּ֥י אֱלֹהִ֖ים רָאִֽינוּ׃

passages.text: But his wife replied, “If the LORD had intended to kill us, He would not have accepted the burnt offering and the grain offering from our hands, nor would He have shown us all these things or spoken to us this way.”
passages.sermon:
Manoah’s wife spoke to him.
She said, “If the LORD wanted to kill us, He would not have accepted our burnt offering.
He would not have accepted our grain offering from our hands.
He would not have shown us all these things.
He would not have let us hear these words.”
passages.original: וַתֹּ֧אמֶר ל֣וֹ אִשְׁתּ֗וֹ לוּ֩ חָפֵ֨ץ יְהוָ֤ה לַהֲמִיתֵ֙נוּ֙ לֹֽא־ לָקַ֤ח מִיָּדֵ֙נוּ֙ עֹלָ֣ה וּמִנְחָ֔ה וְלֹ֥א הֶרְאָ֖נוּ אֶת־ כָּל־ אֵ֑לֶּה וְכָעֵ֕ת לֹ֥א הִשְׁמִיעָ֖נוּ כָּזֹֽאת׃

passages.text: So the woman gave birth to a son and named him Samson. The boy grew, and the LORD blessed him.
passages.sermon:
A woman gave birth to a son.
She named her son Samson.
Samson grew up.
The LORD blessed Samson.
passages.original: וַתֵּ֤לֶד הָֽאִשָּׁה֙ בֵּ֔ן וַתִּקְרָ֥א אֶת־ שְׁמ֖וֹ שִׁמְשׁ֑וֹן וַיִּגְדַּ֣ל הַנַּ֔עַר וַֽיְבָרְכֵ֖הוּ יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: And the Spirit of the LORD began to stir him at Mahaneh-dan, between Zorah and Eshtaol.
passages.sermon:
Samson was a boy.
The LORD blessed Samson.
The Spirit of the LORD began to move Samson.
This happened at Mahaneh-dan.
Mahaneh-dan is between Zorah and Eshtaol.
passages.original: וַתָּ֙חֶל֙ ר֣וּחַ יְהוָ֔ה לְפַעֲמ֖וֹ בְּמַחֲנֵה־ דָ֑ן בֵּ֥ין צָרְעָ֖ה וּבֵ֥ין אֶשְׁתָּאֹֽל׃פ
